svg.text: * Solo Codex Luna main agents (A27 on GPT-6 Luna, A29 on GPT-5.6 Luna, both at high effort): A27 failed 2 of 10 runs and A29 1 of 10 on all five acceptance rounds. A27 rep 1 kept failing report-stale; rep 3 kept failing the stale and fresh
transitions and report-stale; A29 rep 9 kept failing its own CTF test. Every run of the solo Sol arms (A26, A28) and of A30 passed.
